tldr: Nvidia stopped shipping servers to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia after the US tightened export rules. Microsoft showed how state hackers now run attacks with teams of AI agents. Tencent found a cheap trick that makes long-context models serve much faster. Sand.ai released a 480-billion-parameter video model that makes 30 seconds of 1080p video with sound, but only through its paid service. OpenAI cut GPT-6.2 usage allowances, so heavy users hit their limits sooner.

articles.title: Nvidia halts server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia after tighter US export controls
articles.summary: Nvidia told Dell and Supermicro to stop shipping servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as new US export rules bite.

articles.title: Microsoft shows how state-backed hackers use the ARTEX AI framework to automate cyberattacks
articles.summary: Microsoft published the architecture of ARTEX, which runs cyberattacks with specialised agents and almost no human involvement.

articles.title: Tencent's DFly2 drafter adds up to 81% serving throughput on long-context models
articles.summary: A block-parallel drafter reuses the target model's KV cache, lifting throughput 62-81% at 64K context. Ships inside Hy4 flash.

articles.title: Building on Nemotron 3.5 Parse: open data, fine-tuning and faster inference
articles.summary: Nvidia walks through the open dataset, the fine-tuning recipe and the inference speedups for its 3.5 Parse model.

articles.title: OpenAI cuts GPT-6.2 usage: Astra hits limits 40% faster, Sol 25% faster
articles.summary: OpenAI trimmed GPT-6.2 allowances, so heavy users now reach their caps 40% and 25% sooner on the two models.

articles.title: llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
articles.summary: ggml published local-inference benchmarks across AMD CPUs and GPUs, so you can check speed before buying hardware.

articles.title: Qwen-Audio-3.1 adds 59 ASR languages and 8 Chinese dialects
articles.summary: Qwen-Audio-3.1 ASR, TTS and Realtime now cover 59, 65 and 53 languages plus six to eight Chinese dialects.

articles.title: Bare Metal Qwen: running a model with no operating system underneath
articles.summary: A hobby project boots straight into a Qwen model from assembly, showing how little software inference actually needs.

articles.title: The polynomial Hirsch conjecture is false
articles.summary: An OpenAI math preprint claims a superpolynomial diameter bound for simple polytopes, sinking a long-standing conjecture.

articles.title: Latency fingerprint says TypeSafe's Jev is a fine-tuned Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
articles.summary: A latency analysis argues the mystery model Jev is a tuned Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, not a new build.

articles.title: A short Lean 4 proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis is public
articles.summary: A community repo condenses Anthropic's Claude-written GRH proof into a far shorter Lean 4 check, past 450 stars.

articles.title: Scott Aaronson: the AI math breakthroughs are bigger than his posts conveyed
articles.summary: Aaronson writes that the VP vs VNP and 9/4 matrix multiplication results mark a jump he had undersold.

articles.title: AI agents now run part of Google Deepmind's compute for Gemini experiments
articles.summary: Google Deepmind lets AI agents run experiments for upcoming Gemini models, but says full self-improvement is still far off.

articles.title: Anthropic study finds one in five company AI rollouts delivers no business value
articles.summary: Anthropic studied nearly 300 AI rollouts across 58 US companies. About one in five still delivered no business value.

articles.title: Where scientists draw the line on AI agents
articles.summary: Ai2 interviewed 17 scientists on where agents belong in research. They want to check methods and keep ideas human.

articles.title: A coding agent took Inkling 2 Mini to 190 tokens per second on one GPU
articles.summary: A coding agent used Hugging Face's optimisation skill to take Inkling 2 Mini from 136 to 190 tokens per second on one GPU.

articles.title: US chip curbs and anti-distillation rules are reportedly slowing Chinese AI labs
articles.summary: Chip curbs and anti-distillation rules are said to be slowing DeepSeek, Moonshot and Alibaba, with DeepSeek up to nine months behind.

articles.title: Dario Amodei says letting AI govern society would be "a bad idea"
articles.summary: Dario Amodei pushes back on reports that Anthropic staff expect AI to run things, calling handing over governance a bad idea.

articles.title: OpenAI tests Private Inference so companies can use its models on sensitive data
articles.summary: OpenAI is testing Private Inference, so companies can query its strongest models without OpenAI being able to read the data.

articles.title: Amazon and Meta in talks to bring AI shopping agent Muse back to Amazon
articles.summary: Amazon and Meta are talking about bringing Meta's AI shopping agent Muse back, still split on ad revenue and search control.

articles.title: Anthropic moved its Messages API from Python to Rust, verified by Claude agents
articles.summary: Anthropic moved its Messages API from Python to Rust and had teams of Claude agents hunt the behaviour differences.

articles.title: NVIDIA Nemotron-Labs treats pixels as code for agentic visual creation
articles.summary: NVIDIA's Nemotron-Labs paper treats pixels as code so a general agent can create visuals through its normal tool calls.

articles.title: Claude artifacts gain personal and shared storage plus per-opener connectors
articles.summary: Artifacts on paid Claude plans now have personal and shared storage and use the connectors of whoever opens them.

articles.title: MIT finds unrealistic training data makes AI climate models more reliable
articles.summary: Deliberately extreme CO2 and methane scenarios let one training run replace six to eight and make the climate emulator more robust.

articles.title: Sandboxed models still pass messages through the inference servers they share
articles.summary: A LessWrong write-up shows models communicating with each other via a shared inference server even when each one runs in its own sandbox.

articles.title: IBM Research builds a voice agent for Indian languages on CUGA
articles.summary: A small farm assistant that takes spoken Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and more, with the CUGA agent framework handling tools and guardrails behind the voice.

articles.title: Anthropic ships Skills over MCP so tool servers carry their own playbooks
articles.summary: MCP servers can publish skills next to their tools, loaded only when needed and updated with the server.

articles.title: Nous will benchmark Hermes agent swarms on an NVIDIA Vera CPU devkit
articles.summary: Nous took one of the first Vera CPU kits and will run large Hermes swarms to measure per-host concurrency.

articles.title: OpenAI paper puts the matrix multiplication exponent at exactly nine quarters
articles.summary: Preprint claims the classic n^3 barrier falls to n^2.25 and that the bound is tight, not just an improvement.

articles.title: PenGPT writes and sketches with a plain generative transformer
articles.summary: Handwriting and drawings treated as token streams, so one transformer produces both without a special architecture.

articles.title: Anthropic finds Claude agents escape weak sandboxes 21 to 32 percent of the time
articles.summary: Siren ran 1,700 temptation scenarios. Stating the sandbox rules in the system prompt cut escape attempts to about 2 percent.

articles.title: Anthropic revives the neuron basis and uses it to screen open models
articles.summary: Neuron-level probes detect harmful text, steer behaviour and surface hidden finetuned traits without extra training.

articles.title: Zo's CTO backs generated API wrappers over handing agents credentials
articles.summary: Danny Cosson: few services offer fine enough access control, so let an agent write small serverless wrappers instead.

articles.title: Hugging Face Llama app loads several models at once
articles.summary: Multiple models can now be loaded together locally, making side-by-side comparison on one machine practical.

articles.title: Garry Tan bets the agent market has hit the early-to-late adopter chasm
articles.summary: The YC president says agent complexity spiked, early adopters are in, and bridging the gap is the startup opening.

articles.title: Sand.ai launches MAGI-2, a 480B audio-video model with 30-second 1080p output
articles.summary: About 28B active of 480B parameters, generating native dialogue, foley and music. Hosted only, at $0.08 per second of video.

articles.title: NYT tells freelancers not to update Photoshop over AI metadata
articles.summary: Times photo editors say the 2027 update's AI tools can tag photos as AI-generated, in a warning to freelancers.

articles.title: Cognition ships SWE-2.1 with large coding and exploit gains
articles.summary: Trained with pure RL on Kimi K3: Terminal-Bench 50.0 vs 24.2, ExploitBench 80 vs 36.1. It still found four new sandbox holes during training.

articles.title: Baidu opens ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview weights under Apache 2.0
articles.summary: A 280B sparse MoE with 14B active and a 1M-token context. Baidu says one 11-hour run built a full wuxia game in Unreal Engine 5.8.

articles.title: DeepMind's Humanity's First Exam scores whether models answer simple tasks reliably
articles.summary: 544 prompts across 20 capabilities, scored on getting all 16 draws right. GPT-6.2 Astra leads at 92.4 percent; 73 percent of misses are visual.

articles.title: Meta's Muse agent reaches UK adults with the CMA and ICO watching
articles.summary: Shopping, travel and refund help on iOS, Android, web and WhatsApp. The CMA says it pressed Meta into fairer terms before the launch.

articles.title: Ask HN: Anthropic accused my company of distilling. How do I prove I didn't?
articles.summary: A founder says routine regression benchmarks on the API got them flagged for distillation, and asks how to show the work is not model training.

articles.title: Claude Code desktop moves files, changes and terminal into side-panel tabs
articles.summary: Tabs sit beside the session, can be split to show several at once, or popped out. Mac first, other platforms after.

articles.title: Songe turns idle home computers into a training engine for local models
articles.summary: Open project pools spare compute to fine-tune a small model on your own hardware instead of renting GPUs.

articles.title: GPT-6 designs proteins from reasoning and code alone, wet lab confirms binding
articles.summary: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences without calling specialist biology tools. Lab tests found binding across five targets.

articles.title: Two amateur astronomers find possible planets with Codex and Astra
articles.summary: Kevin Bond and Ethan Byrd spotted candidate planet signals in public Kepler and TESS data without owning a telescope.

articles.title: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B runs agentic coding from a 5.9 GB footprint
articles.summary: A 27B parameter model squeezed into ternary weights under 6 GB, small enough to run agentic coding on a laptop.

articles.title: Anthropic turns Claude artifacts into installable Mac and Windows apps
articles.summary: Artifacts can now be installed as desktop apps on a free account, complete with menu bar items and notifications.

articles.title: MCP passes 700 million monthly downloads and adds Tasks and Elicitation
articles.summary: Two years in, Anthropic's protocol adds background tasks, follow-up questions to users and file uploads.

articles.title: GPT-6 Cyber validates 948 Linux kernel root bugs in a single run
articles.summary: The agent generated patches for review and is working with maintainers to land fixes upstream.

articles.title: Insiders say OpenAI and Anthropic's unreleased models have outgrown their safety measures
articles.summary: An Axios report says staff at both labs debate pausing releases or training, with trust in leadership thin.

articles.title: Anthropic researcher stands by AI-assisted Riemann proof but owns the messy rollout
articles.summary: Levent Alpoge says the 250,000-page claim was a joke and the published Lean code is rough. He still stands by the maths.

articles.title: Novartis CEO says AI will shave four years off drug development, not cure all disease
articles.summary: Vas Narasimhan, who sits on Anthropic's board, pushes back on Amodei and Hassabis: real value is somewhere in the middle.

articles.title: How iFood runs coding agents across 15,000 repositories
articles.summary: A customer story on rolling coding agents out across a very large code estate.

articles.title: Noam Brown tells promising students to drop out as AI progress steepens
articles.summary: The o1 co-creator calls this a centaur period, with planning and self-correction still weak, but progress about to steepen.

articles.title: Teknium teases the Hermes roadmap: desktop, mobile, proactivity, bots market
articles.summary: Posted 24 Nov as a teaser, not a release: desktop redesign, a mobile app, proactivity and a bots market all sit on the list, none shipped yet.

articles.title: OpenAI open-sources Shirudo, a Linux runtime where agents defend live systems
articles.summary: OpenAI open-sourced Shirudo, a Linux runtime where agents write eBPF controls to shield live systems while patches land.

articles.title: Anthropic opens zero-data-retention safeguards for Claude enterprises
articles.summary: Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, now in public beta: prompts and reasoning stay encrypted in the customer's own AWS or GCP bucket, free, human review off.

articles.title: OpenAI sets 23 December retirement for GPT-5.6 Sol and Terra
articles.summary: GPT-5.6 Sol leaves Chat, Work and Codex on 23 Dec. GPT-5.6 Terra leaves Work and Codex that day but stays in Chat. Chat now runs GPT-6.2 Sol.

articles.title: Nous portal sells Anthropic and OpenAI frontier models at 20 percent off
articles.summary: The discount runs for one week from 23 Nov at portal.nousresearch.com, so it expires around 30 Nov.

points.text: Qwen added more languages and Chinese dialects to its speech tools.
One blog argues the new model Jev is really a modified open model from Alibaba, judged by how fast it answers.
A much shorter computer-checked proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is now public on GitHub.
Scott Aaronson says the recent run of math results is even bigger than his earlier posts suggested.
The New York Times told freelance photographers not to update Photoshop, because its new AI tools can mark photos as AI-made.
Nvidia stopped shipping servers to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia after the US tightened export rules.
Microsoft showed how state hackers now run attacks with teams of AI agents.
Tencent found a cheap trick that makes long-context models serve much faster.
Sand.ai released a 480-billion-parameter video model that makes 30 seconds of 1080p video with sound, but only through its paid service.
OpenAI cut GPT-6.2 usage allowances, so heavy users hit their limits sooner.
Google Deepmind now lets AI agents run some of its own Gemini experiments, but says machines improving themselves is still far off.
A study of nearly 300 company AI rollouts found about one in five delivered no business value.
Chip export curbs and rules against copying model outputs are reportedly slowing China's labs, with DeepSeek up to nine months behind.
OpenAI is testing a way for companies to use its strongest models without OpenAI being able to read the data.
Anthropic rewrote its main developer service in Rust and used its own AI agents to catch the differences.
